title: Bee Removal in Hewlett, NY
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Hewlett, Long Island. Licensed technicians treat nests in walls, attics, and wood. Honeybee colonies referred to beekeepers.
intro: When wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, or ground-nesting bees establish nests in your Hewlett property, you need fast and effective treatment from licensed professionals. The Best Pest Control NYC provides complete nest treatment and removal services throughout Hewlett and the Five Towns area — identifying the species, treating the nest, removing accessible material, and sealing entry points to prevent recolonization. Our technicians respond quickly to stinging insect problems in homes and businesses across this beautiful Long Island community.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC brings over a decade of specialized experience to Hewlett properties, with deep knowledge of the bee species common to Long Island's South Shore. Our technicians use proven, eco-conscious methods that prioritize safety for your family, pets, and the environment while delivering lasting results at transparent, competitive prices.
localContext: Hewlett's tree-lined streets, waterfront properties near Hewlett Harbor, and mix of classic colonials and modern homes create ideal nesting opportunities for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets. The proximity to Hewlett Bay Park and the area's mature landscaping means residential properties often encounter wasp and hornet nests in soffits, wall voids, attics, and eaves during spring and summer months. Carpenter bees bore into fascia boards, deck rails, and trim — particularly on older colonials with exposed wood. Ground-nesting yellow jackets and bumble bees establish colonies in lawn edges, under decks, and near foundation plantings, requiring prompt professional attention.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Hewlett?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you treat a wasp or hornet nest in my Hewlett property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day or next-day service for most Hewlett stinging insect requests. Once on-site, most nest treatments can be completed within 1–3 hours depending on the nest location and access. Emergency services are available for situations posing immediate danger to residents or visitors.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Hewlett?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What types of stinging insects are common in Hewlett homes?
faqs.answer: Hewlett properties most commonly experience problems with yellow jackets, paper wasps, bald-faced hornets (nesting in soffits, wall voids, attics, and eaves), carpenter bees (boring into wood trim, fascia, and deck rails), and ground-nesting bees and yellow jackets in lawns and under decks. Our team accurately identifies each species and applies the appropriate treatment method to eliminate the nest and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
